summary: the edge gate's significance hurdle is read against the distribution its statistic actually follows — Student's t on the cohorts its Fama-MacBeth standard error was estimated from, not a fixed normal quantile: the t-hurdle dial is converted once into the confidence it always claimed (alpha = 1 - Phi(hurdle), value unchanged) and the surplus tested against it on cohorts-1 degrees of freedom, so a source with three resolved cohorts can no longer release the whole planned book on a ~91% test wearing a 97.7% label; exactly a no-op in the large-sample limit, strictly conservative below it (ADR-0081)
